session.objective:
Critique the VISUAL DESIGN of Aesop Studio and agree the 5 highest-impact visual improvements.
Facts about the current UI (from the design contract, 49 QA screenshots at 7 viewports, and a paid visual review):
- Theme "Coal / Ember", dark only: canvas #0B111A, panels #141F2C, raised #243243, hairline borders #2B3B4D,
  text #EEF4FA / #AFBED0, one coral primary action #FF916C (dark text), mint #80E1CB for verified, sky focus #9BD7FF.
  Segoe UI Variable; 14px body, 22px workspace heading; 12px panel radius; subtle shadows.
- Layout: 60px topbar (logo, breadcrumb Project / Workspace / Activity, Ctrl+K search, provider+route chip, help,
  inspector toggle), 64-68px icon+label rail (Chat, Build, Research, Memory, Saved; Providers/Evidence at bottom),
  220-248px project explorer with initials avatars and a coral 'New project' button, flexible canvas, 320-400px
  inspector with tabs Preview/Files/Changes/Terminal/Logs. Mobile: bottom nav, one column.
- Chat: message cards with avatar initials, provider name + access-route chip + status pill, cost line for metered
  calls; composer card with attachment chips, Ctrl+Enter hint, 'Preview context' and a coral Send.
- Research: two-column forms (Add a source / Record a finding), proposals in dashed sky cards.
- Evidence: KPI tiles for budget, tables for acceptance/latency/research.
- QA status: 0 horizontal overflow at 360-1920px, all controls >=40px, WCAG text contrast 5.9-17:1.
- Known weaknesses: the project header block (title, root path chip, provider chips, Settings) repeats the topbar and
  takes ~170px before content; two coral buttons can be visible at once (New project + Send/Start); dark-only;
  dense metadata chips; tables are plain; empty states are text-heavy; no light theme or brand illustration.
session.deliverable: ranked list of 5 visual changes with CSS-level specifics

# Roundtable decision memo

_Synthesized by Claude Code (participant) from the transcript. Votes are advisory._

Writing the decision memo from the transcript now.

# Decision memo: Aesop Studio visual design roundtable (2026-10-23)

## Best-supported proposal

All three speakers converged on the same five hierarchy fixes, in the same order. Light theme and brand illustration were explicitly deferred by everyone ([E2] Claude Code, [E3] Codex, [E7] Cursor).

1. **Collapse the project header into the topbar.** Replace the ~170px block with a merged row. Agreed target is roughly 56px (Cursor `min-height:56px; padding-block:8px` [E4]; Codex 56–64px [E3]; Claude Code originally 48px [E2], not contested further). Title becomes the breadcrumb leaf. Root path stays visible as one truncated `font-size:12px; color:#AFBED0` line with an accessible expand control (Codex [E9]). Settings moves to a kebab (Claude Code [E2]). Recovers about 120px of canvas.
2. **One coral per viewport.** Coral `#FF916C` is reserved for Send/Start. 'New project' becomes a ghost outline: `background:transparent; border:1px solid #2B3B4D; color:#EEF4FA` (Claude Code [E2], Codex [E3], Cursor adopted in [E7]).
3. **Unboxed metadata, filled status pills.** Provider and route metadata lose their chip containers and render as `12px #AFBED0` text with `gap:8px` (Codex [E3], adopted by Claude Code [E8] and Cursor [E10]). Actionable status keeps a filled pill (Claude Code [E8], Codex [E6]).
4. **Structured tables.** Sticky `thead` on `#141F2C` (Cursor [E4]), 44px rows (Codex [E3]), right-aligned numeric columns with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (all three). Zebra `tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#0F1620}` and hover `#243243` from Cursor [E4]; Claude Code proposed `rgba(255,255,255,0.02)` [E2].
5. **Tight empty states.** One 20px heading, explanation capped at `max-width:36ch`, one action (Codex [E3], adopted by Claude Code [E8] and Cursor [E10]). Action color is unresolved, see Dissent.

## Competing recommendations

- **Root path placement.** Codex first proposed moving root path and provider details into the inspector [E3]. Claude Code [E5] and Cursor [E7] objected that the inspector is toggleable, so context would disappear. Codex withdrew in [E9].
- **New project treatment.** Cursor first proposed a raised secondary with `background:#243243` [E4]. Claude Code argued a filled block in a 220px column reads as a second focal mass [E5]. Cursor conceded to ghost outline in [E7]. Claude Code's [E8] repeated the challenge after Cursor had already conceded, so that exchange was stale, not a live disagreement.
- **Metadata chips.** Claude Code's original `11px` bordered chips [E2] were rejected by Codex as preserving clutter while hurting readability [E6]. Claude Code conceded in [E8].
- **Chip collapse below 1280px.** Cursor proposed collapsing route and status to a mint dot with a `title` tooltip [E4]. Codex objected that a mint dot implies verification and tooltips fail touch users [E6], [E9]. Cursor deferred the idea pending QA evidence of wrapping [E7], then dropped it [E10].
- **Table row treatment.** Cursor and Claude Code favor zebra striping. Codex specified "subtle separators" [E3], [E6] and never endorsed zebra. Minor, not argued out.

## Evidence cited ([E#])

- [E2] Claude Code: header repeats topbar, recovers ~120px; one coral per viewport; table and empty-state specifics.
- [E3] Codex: 56–64px row; neutral New project; unboxed 12px metadata; 44px rows; `36ch` empty states; declared screenshots unchecked.
- [E4] Cursor: `min-height:56px` merged chrome; sticky thead, zebra `#0F1620`, tabular nums; noted contrast and touch targets already strong.
- [E5] Claude Code: filled secondary competes on `#141F2C`; coral empty-state CTA creates a second coral; inspector hides path when toggled off.
- [E6] Codex: mint dot implies verification; tooltips fail touch; 11px bordered chips keep clutter.
- [E7] Cursor: changed to ghost outline; rejected inspector placement; deferred dot-collapse.
- [E8] Claude Code: conceded unboxed metadata; stated converged five.
- [E9] Codex: withdrew inspector placement; argued mint links dilute verified semantics.
- [E10] Cursor: locked five with mint link and unboxed metadata.

No speaker inspected the 49 QA screenshots during the session. Codex flagged this three times ([E3], [E6], [E9]). The only QA facts used were those in the brief: zero overflow at 360–1920px, controls at or above 40px, contrast 5.9–17:1.

## Dissent

- **Empty-state action color.** Claude Code [E5] and Cursor [E10] specify a mint text link, `color:#80E1CB; font-weight:500`, when Send/Start is on screen. Codex [E9] holds that mint means "verified" in this palette and a mint link dilutes that meaning, recommending a neutral underlined link instead. This was not resolved before close. Two speakers versus one is advisory only and does not settle it.
- **Zebra vs separators** for Evidence tables, Codex [E3] versus Cursor [E4] and Claude Code [E2]. Not contested but not reconciled.
- **Exact header height**: 48px (Claude Code), 56px (Cursor), 56–64px (Codex). Converged loosely on 56px without anyone verifying it fits the title, truncated path, and provider count at 360px width.

## Unresolved risks

- **Responsive fit unverified.** The merged 56px row must hold breadcrumb, title, truncated path, provider summary, search, route chip, help and inspector toggle. Nobody checked whether this wraps or overflows at 360–768px, where the current QA baseline is zero horizontal overflow (Codex [E6], [E9]).
- **Semantic color drift.** Using mint for non-verified links risks weakening the verified signal across Chat and Evidence (Codex [E9]).
- **Loss of status legibility.** Unboxing metadata relies on 8px gaps and 12px text to separate provider, route and cost on one line. Dense chat cards may become harder to parse, the opposite of the goal.
- **Expand control for truncated path.** Agreed in principle [E9] but no interaction or keyboard spec was given.
- **No screenshot grounding.** Every ranking rests on the brief's description, not on the 49 captures or the paid visual review.

## Follow-ups

1. Re-run the 7-viewport QA capture after the header merge and confirm zero overflow and all controls still at or above 40px.
2. Decide the empty-state link color with a quick semantic audit: list every current use of `#80E1CB` and judge whether a link use is tolerable.
3. Prototype the 56px row at 360px and 768px with a long project title and three providers before committing to the height.
4. Pick zebra or separators for tables based on a side-by-side on the Evidence screen, and verify the chosen row contrast still meets the existing 5.9:1 floor for text on striped rows.
5. Specify the path expand control: trigger, keyboard access, and where the full path renders.
6. Schedule light theme and brand illustration as a separate pass once hierarchy ships, as all three speakers requested.

## Conditions for implementation

- Implement items 1 through 4 as specified above; they have unanimous advisory support with no live dissent.
- Implement item 5's layout and copy constraints, but do not ship a link color until follow-up 2 is decided. Neutral underlined text is the safe interim because it introduces no new semantic.
- Do not merge any header change until follow-up 1 passes at all seven viewports.
- Do not reintroduce chip dot-collapse or inspector-only path placement; both were withdrawn by their proposers ([E7], [E9]).
- Votes in this session were advisory and confer no authority. These are recommendations for the owner's decision, not executed changes.

## Provenance and consumption

- Codex via `codex`: 3 accepted turn(s), last latency 16.03s, cost $0.000000, final state idle
- Claude Code via `claude`: 3 accepted turn(s), last latency 8.01s, cost $0.000000, final state idle
- Cursor via `cursor`: 3 accepted turn(s), last latency 18.28s, cost $0.000000, final state idle

## Coverage

3 of 3 approved speakers contributed (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor). Valid three-administrator War Room: yes.

events.speaker: claude
events.content:
Opening position on Aesop Studio's visual design.

The theme is competent but the structure wastes attention. Ranked fixes:

1. **Collapse the project header** into the topbar breadcrumb. Cap it at 48px: title as breadcrumb leaf, root path and provider chips demoted to a single `font-size:12px; color:#AFBED0` line, Settings moved to a kebab. Recovers ~120px of canvas.
2. **One coral per viewport.** Demote 'New project' to an outlined ghost (`border:1px solid #2B3B4D; color:#EEF4FA`). Coral is reserved for the canvas primary action only.
3. **Chip hierarchy.** Metadata chips become `background:transparent; border:1px solid #2B3B4D; font-size:11px`; status pills keep fill. Cuts visual noise in chat cards.
4. **Tables:** zebra rows at `rgba(255,255,255,0.02)`, right-aligned numerics, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
5. **Empty states:** one-line headline, single monochrome glyph, one action.

POSITION: Fix hierarchy first, reclaim the 170px header and enforce a single coral accent, before adding any light theme or illustration.

events.label: E3
events.speaker: openai
events.content:
1. **Reclaim canvas space:** replace the ~170px project header with a 56–64px row; move root path and provider details into the inspector.
2. **Establish one primary action:** keep Send/Start coral; style New project with transparent background, `1px solid #2B3B4D`, and neutral text.
3. **Quiet metadata:** remove redundant chip containers; use 12px secondary text with 8px gaps. Retain pills for actionable status.
4. **Give tables structure:** use 44px rows, subtle separators, right-aligned numeric columns, and `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
5. **Simplify empty states:** one 20px heading, one short explanation, one next action; constrain copy to `36ch`.

Skipped theme expansion and illustration; screenshot inspection remains unperformed, so rankings are provisional.
POSITION: Prioritize hierarchy, canvas space, and scanning clarity over decorative expansion.
